title: System Prompts
description: Master system prompts for controlling model behavior, personality, and output format.

data.text: System prompts set the behavior and personality of the model. They define the role, constraints, and output format for all interactions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: System prompts define model behavior and personality
Set role, constraints, and output format
System prompt applies to all user messages
Include examples in system prompt for consistency
data.takeaway: System prompts are the foundation of reliable LLM interactions. Define clear roles, constraints, and output formats to get consistent results.
